statement: Plan TP-9 specifies $1,450 to savings, locked until January; with rent due today, this would leave only $150 available.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific problem — "$1,450 to savings, locked until January; with rent due today, this would leave only $150 available" — asserting the plan's destination conflicts with the rent obligation.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
